title: Harbor evals for coding agents
summary: Jeff Linwood shows how to test if agents use MCP tools with Harbor Framework.
learn: Set up repeatable tests for agent behavior using the Harbor Framework.
Verify if an agent used specific MCP tools by inspecting the audit log.
Determine that short instructions in agents.md perform better than long descriptions.
Run multiple trials to account for the non-deterministic nature of LLMs.
